title: Lower bound for paired candidate expectation
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be finite sets of candidates, let $d$ be a default candidate, and let $R$ be a decidable relation on pairs of candidates. If $a\in A$, $b\in B$, and $R(a,b)$, then the iterated finite candidate expectation of the indicator of $R$ is at least $1/(|A||B|)$.
hypotheses_covered: A decidable relation on candidate pairs
